name: Streaming GPU-based Voxel Carving
definition: A streaming GPU-based voxel carving method that creates an explicit volume, avoids 3D texture drawbacks by using only surface voxels in a GPU-optimal 2D data representation, and minimizes GPU-CPU data transfer through effective load balancing.
summary: Streaming GPU-based Voxel Carving creates explicit volumes using a GPU-optimal 2D surface-voxel representation to avoid 3D texture overhead and minimize CPU-GPU data transfer for interactive performance.
